handback.title: Every role reads the parent's ask and the owner's words
handback.summary: Workers and reviewers on a story read the parent's ask and the owner's comments; the owner's commits count as words.
handback.user_story: Every role on a story sees the parent's ask, and the owner's comments and commits steer the work.

acceptance_criteria.text: A worker on a split story finds the parent's original issue in its starting pack.
acceptance_criteria.words: Every role working on a split story gets the parent's original issue and my comments, which only the planner gets today.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The owner named none; a split story always has a parent.

acceptance_criteria.text: A worker on a split story finds the owner's comments on the parent in its starting pack.
acceptance_criteria.words: Every role working on a split story gets the parent's original issue and my comments, which only the planner gets today.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The owner named none; a parent with no owner comments gives nothing to find.

acceptance_criteria.text: A reviewer on a split story finds the parent's original issue in its starting pack.
acceptance_criteria.words: Every role working on a split story gets the parent's original issue and my comments, which only the planner gets today.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The owner named none; the test covers both the plan review and the code review.

acceptance_criteria.text: A reviewer on a split story finds the owner's comments on the parent in its starting pack.
acceptance_criteria.words: Every role working on a split story gets the parent's original issue and my comments, which only the planner gets today.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The owner named none; the test covers both the plan review and the code review.

acceptance_criteria.text: Text the owner committed on the branch counts as the owner's words a criterion may quote.
acceptance_criteria.words: Anything I write counts as my words

edge_cases.case: A line someone else committed on the branch is not taken as the owner's words.

acceptance_criteria.text: The owner's comment that says /review on a pull request starts its code review.
acceptance_criteria.words: I can add, change or delete tests, plan and code on Dokima's branches, then say /review.

edge_cases.case: A pull request comment with /review on a later line starts nothing.

acceptance_criteria.text: The owner's /plan comment reaches the next planner in its starting pack, word for word.
acceptance_criteria.words: Yes, plans live off the branch; I edit them by comment.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The owner named none; already built, the test pins it.

test_changes.tests/test_agent.py::test_a_command_star: Adds `/review` on a later line of a pull request comment, which starts nothing.
test_changes.tests/test_agent.py::test_the_pack_reads: Also builds the planner's pack and finds the owner's `/plan` comment word for word.

answers.why: The older test now also builds the planner's pack and finds the owner's plan comment word for word.
The check rejects new tests that pass today; the older test now also covers review on a later line.
